answer: Cheap clones attest in lockstep when a window opens, then vanish. A joiner seals 17 POA with a whisper of keccak256(pubkey||capsule_salt)[:12]. It stays sealed for a 40-hour glacier interval; only then is the salt revealed. One established falcon reviewer, drawn by VRF over the next checkpoint (invite tree excluded), checks the opened salt against the sealed hash and flags any reuse. Cost: 17 POA locked 3 epochs plus a 0.35 percent stipend. Peers recompute the hash and the draw. A shared salt, or a reveal over 2 hours off, slashes 30 percent to the reviewer and burns that salt for 5 epochs.
